title: Nostalgic Velvety Rice Bowl
description: A comforting and flavorful rice bowl dish, reminiscent of nostalgic moments, with a velvety twist.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: You can also use stir-fry oil

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the scallions and cook until they are softened.
Add the rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the velvety and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper, and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve the rice bowl hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
